soru: What was Selim doing when the lights went out?
kanit: Selim was in the middle of an online game when his screen went black.

soru: Why couldn't Selim get any news?
kanit: His phone had forty percent battery, but the mobile network was overloaded.

soru: What caused the blackout, according to the radio?
tr: Radyoya göre elektrik kesintisinin sebebi neydi?
secenekler: A problem at a power station
kanit: The radio said that there was a problem with a power station outside the city

soru: What could they see in the sky?
secenekler: The Milky Way and thousands of stars

soru: What do the neighbours do every month now?
tr: Komşular artık her ay ne yapıyor?
secenekler: They meet on the roof and watch the stars
They have a party in the street
kanit: And on the first Tuesday of every month, the neighbours meet on the roof, turn off their phones, and wait for the stars.
At 8:43 on a Tuesday evening in July, the whole city went dark.
